page_text_ocr_zh: “我好幸运啊！”青蛙弗洛格一边欣赏着自己在水中的倒影，一边说，“我漂亮、会游泳，跳水又比其他人跳得好。我是绿色的，而绿色是我最喜欢的颜色。这世上最好的事就是做一只青蛙。”
page_text_en: "I'm so lucky!" Frog Floppy, while admiring his reflection in the water, said, "I'm beautiful, I can swim, and I jump into the water better than anyone else. I'm green, and green is my favorite color. The best thing in the world is being a frog."
summary_zh: 青蛙弗洛格站在水边，欣赏水中倒影，自信地表达自己对自身特点的喜爱，认为做青蛙是世上最好的事。

page_text_ocr_zh: “那我呢？”小鸭问，“我是白色的。难道你不觉得我也很漂亮吗？”“才不呢！”弗洛格说，“你身上没有绿色。”“但是我会飞呀，”小鸭说，“而你又不会。”
page_text_en: "What about me?" asked the duck. "I'm white. Don't you think I'm beautiful too?" "No way!" said Frog. "You don't have any green on you." "But I can fly," said the duck. "And you can't."

page_text_ocr_zh: “哦，是吗？”弗洛格说，“我从没有看你飞过。”“我是有点儿懒。”小鸭说，“但是我真的可以飞。你看！”她跑了几步，用力地扇动翅膀。
page_text_en: "Oh, is that so?" said Frog, "I've never seen you fly." "I'm a bit lazy," said Duck, "but I really can fly. Look!" She ran a few steps and flapped her wings hard.

page_text_ocr_zh: 然后，小鸭突然从地面升起，优雅地飞向天空。她飞了几圈后，降落在弗洛格面前的草地上。“太棒了！”弗洛格大叫，崇拜地说，“我也想要飞！”“你不行！”小鸭说，“你没有翅膀。”说完很得意地回家了。

page_text_en: So Frog started practicing flying by himself. He ran forward a few steps, then spread his arms and flapped up and down, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't lift off the ground.

page_text_ocr_zh:
学会对自己有信心

每一样东西都有自己的独特之处，人也是一样。有自己的长处和短处。也许你长得不够漂亮，也许你不够聪明。没有关系，你一定有别人没有的亮点。不要怀疑自己，相信自己，做你自己！

想一想
1. 弗洛格为什么觉得自己很幸运？
2. 弗洛格看到小鸭能飞，他去做了什么？
3. 野兔对弗洛格说了什么？

试一试
大声说出自己的优点。对自己说：“我最棒！”
page_text_en:
Learn to Believe in Yourself

Everything has its own unique qualities, and people are the same. Everyone has strengths and weaknesses. Maybe you’re not pretty enough, or maybe you’re not smart enough. It doesn’t matter—you definitely have something special that no one else has. Don’t doubt yourself. Believe in yourself. Be yourself!

Think About It
1. Why did Frog feel lucky?
2. What did Frog do when he saw Duck flying?
3. What did Rabbit say to Frog?

Try This
Speak out your strengths aloud. Say to yourself: “I’m the best!”

The author, Max Velthuijs, is a children's picture book artist highly acclaimed internationally.
This series has won the Dutch Golden Pencil Award, the French Prix de Treize Award, the German Bestlist Award, and the American Graphic Award.

"With consistent sincerity and tact, it portrays the emotional fluctuations of the frog Frog." —— The Guardian, UK

This is a series of psychological education stories that help children's mental growth. Each story naturally reveals an important theme and is full of imagination. Both text and illustrations are created by Max Velthuijs. The text is lively and subtly humorous, while the illustrations feature a unique simple-line style, hailed by Western artists as "a masterpiece of simple-line art." The series has been translated into 38 languages and has sold over a million copies worldwide.
